title: Muggy with a chance of scattered rain across Maryland - NewsBreak
text:
By Cutter Martin ,
15 hours ago
Warm, humid and rain chances in Maryland 03:03
We have a decent stretch of mid-August weather through Friday across Maryland. Plan on warm and humid weather with occasional chances of rain through the end of the workweek.
Muggy weather, few storms possible across Maryland If you're trying to view the Perseids meteor shower later tonight , the weather may give a few challenges. There will be quite a few clouds around tonight, along with scattered showers and possibly a couple of thunderstorms. Aside from clouds, the best viewing will be in the pre-dawn hours away from city lights.
Thursday will be hotter and a bit more humid. The temperature will peak around 90° late in the afternoon. Though, it will feel like it's in the low to mid-90s. A passing shower or thunderstorm is possible during the daytime, however, that risk is low.
Friday will be very warm and muggy with a few passing showers and storms. The day, as a whole, will not be a washout. But, rain could send a few plans indoors. Rain should end Friday evening.
Weekend weather is nice Saturday, few storms and muggier Sunday Saturday is the pick day of the weekend.
Under a mix of sun and clouds, temperatures will peak in the low to mid-80s on Saturday afternoon. If you're planning on going to the Ravens' first preseason game against the Eagles on Saturday evening, the forecast looks awesome by August standards.
The First Alert Weather team is forecasting quiet conditions, comfortable humidity and a kickoff temperature in the 70s.
There will be some changes to our weather on Sunday. Plan on more clouds, especially during the afternoon and evening hours with a growing chance of scattered showers and thunderstorms. The chance of rain and thunder increases on Monday, before we dry out nicely for the middle of next week.
